root_cause: The stable ~147 ms official median is not a constant half-beat flip of either track's stored grid, and it is not tempo/BPM drift. S.P.Y's post-drop-1 breakdown [128, 160] is a section-local half-time groove on an otherwise correct drop-locked 174 metronome: isolated kicks in that region sit near half a beat off the stored downbeats, while snares stay near the grid, and the kick-on-1 / snare-on-2-and-4 template prefers a half-beat shift only in this region (margin +1.21, above the existing 0.5 line). Prep's half-beat check is global and is dominated by the on-grid drops, so half_off stays false and the grid is never shifted — correctly, because flipping it would break drop 1, drop 2, and the snares. Official blend_diag then takes a 2-bar kick+snare xcorr on the five loud overlap bars 130-134 (values 91.4, -111.7, 161.1, 161.1, 146.6) and reports the median 146.6. A 1-bar window on the same bars is 88.5 ms (the breakdown phase walking from +21 ms on 128-135 toward +129 ms on 136-143), not a clean half-beat lock. The pro clip shows the same breakdown-kick displacement against the same stored grid (4 of 6 strong kicks near half a beat, abs median 155 ms). After alignment, beat_identity diff is 7.3 ms: our LEADIN_LOCK placement already matches the pro. ONBEAT_RIDE correctly refused to apply (only 3 bars had kicks from both decks within 40 ms of the downbeat). Loosening that confidence floor, or chasing 147 ms with another constant lock, would ride Meteorites off its on-grid piano phrase and away from the pro.

SPY_global.verdict: drops are on the stored downbeats; do not flip the track grid

Meteorites_global.note: high offbeat_ratio is syncopated drop kicks; snares clearly on 2 and 4, template strongly prefers the stored grid

Meteorites_leadin_32_48.note: messy lead-in; LEADIN_LOCK used 32-39 at -64.7 ms, strength 3.61

official_xcorr.note: 2-bar kick+snare hops toward a half-beat; 1-bar still ~88 ms because the outgoing phase is walking, not because Meteorites is flipped.

vs_pro.verdict: The pro leaves S.P.Y's breakdown kicks off the drop-locked downbeats the same way the source does. Our constant lead-in lock already matches that relationship.

ride_and_checks.piano_note: False fail: BASS_FILL_GAPS already has lows up at mix 140-144 (pre_low -26.9 vs ev_low -25.0, need +3 dB). Mid band at 144 still rises (-24.1 vs lead-in mid -30.6). The piano is present; the lows jump was used as a proxy and the fill removed it.

what_not_to_do: Do not flip either track's stored grid (drops and Meteorites snares are correct; a global or pinned half-beat shift would break them).
Do not loosen ONBEAT_RIDE's 4-bar / 40 ms confidence floor to force a ride.
Do not apply another constant lock to chase the 146.6 ms official median (that number is a 2-bar hop plus the outgoing breakdown's later +129 ms kick phase).
Do not ride Meteorites to follow S.P.Y's later breakdown kicks: that would unalign the on-grid piano phrase and diverge from the pro (currently 7.3 ms).
general_analysis_fix: Treat official kick+snare xcorr as untrusted when the outgoing overlap is a post-drop half-time breakdown (section-local half-beat template margin >= 0.5, or an existing half-time section). Use isolated snares and/or on-beat-only kick lags, and compare to the pro with beat_identity. Prep's half-beat check should stay global (do not re-grid a breakdown independently of its drops). Incoming lock should stay anchored to the lead-in phrase, not to later outgoing kick syncopation.
